notes.title: PERFORMACE UPDATE
notes.content:
Game now should run 20-30% smoother.

If you want to make game work better make sure you use the graphics card not the inter CPU.

1. For even better results go to desktop and click right on some free spot. Then go to Display Settings and find at the button "Graphics settings" With selected Desktop app click on "Browse" .Then find the .exe file of the game( Place you download the game ).
When you add the app click on it and go to "Options" And set the Graphics preference to HIGH PERFORMACE.

2. Also you can go to NVIDIA Control Panel and change the preferences in "Adjust image settings with preview". Click on "Use my preference emphasizing" and set it to Balanced or Performance.

Hope game works better with all that settings.
